description: Live telemetry: evaluation counts by verdict, flag/block rates, latency percentiles, findings by signature and check, and measurement: per-stage latency (patterns, judge, Crossref), judge usage (calls, cache hits, errors, skips, tokens, cost estimate when prices are configured), Crossref outcomes, and judge overrides by signature. Counts and timings only: the audit log and metrics never store response text.
name: aegis_get_telemetry
